Factions.Name: Númenor
Factions.Description: The island kingdom of Men was famed for its ships, stonework, and disciplined armies. Númenor combines strong infrastructure and coastal power with costly, high-quality troops rather than overwhelming numbers.

Technologies.Name: Masonry of Armenelos
Technologies.History: The white citadel of Armenelos crowns the king's city, and its strongholds were raised to outlast the pride of even the Lords of the Sea.

Technologies.Name: Dúnedain Tempering
Technologies.History: The forge-halls of the Númenóreans temper steel for the heirs of the Edain, joining the blessing of the Valar with a smith's craft.

Technologies.Name: Fleet of the Lords of the Sea
Technologies.History: The great armaments of Ar-Pharazôn sailed with ballista and ram, and the shorelines of Middle-earth learned to fear the horizon.

Technologies.Name: King's Building-craft
Technologies.History: The Númenóreans raise their quarters and storehouses in orderly rows, planned by the king's architects and raised by disciplined crews.

Technologies.Name: Shipwrights of the Royal Harbour
Technologies.History: The shipwrights of Rómenna build the island's fleets, and their nets and lines feed the greatest navy the world has known.

Heroes.Name: Elendil
Heroes.History: Elendil improves nearby infantry attack and sight.

Heroes.Name: Isildur
Heroes.History: Isildur is a duelist who strengthens nearby infantry and is especially dangerous to enemy heroes.

Heroes.Name: Ar-Pharazôn
Heroes.History: Ar-Pharazôn strengthens Númenórean warships; his ambition also raises land-unit metal costs while he lives.

CivBonuses.Name: Blessing of the West
CivBonuses.History: The Edain were raised above other Men by the Valar, and the Númenóreans grew taller, wiser, and longer-lived than any other kindred of Men.
CivBonuses.Description: Non-hero Númenórean infantry have +5% health. The Dúnedain are long-lived and strong, but remain mortal.

CivBonuses.Name: Great Houses of the Dúnedain
CivBonuses.History: The great houses and kindreds of Númenor — the King's Men, the Faithful, and the houses of Bëor, Hador, and Haleth — settled the land in ordered realms under the King's Tower in Armenelos.
CivBonuses.Description: Houses support +10% population. Númenor's strength is disciplined settlement, not endless levies.

CivBonuses.Name: Fortified Havens
CivBonuses.History: The Numenóreans were the greatest mariners of the world, and their havens, from Rómennölië to Andúnië, were strong in stone and sheltered their great fleets.
CivBonuses.Description: Docks +15% health. Coastal strongholds anchor Númenor's sea power.

Structures.Name: Rómennölië
Structures.History: The Royal Harbour of Rómenna sends Númenor's fleets across the sea.
Structures.Description: Trains Númenórean warships and researches naval technologies.

Structures.Name: Coast Guard Tower
Structures.History: Númenor's coastal watch protects its havens from ships and raiders.
Structures.Description: A tower specialized against ships and coastal landings.

Structures.Name: Temple of Armenelos
Structures.History: The temple of the royal city embodies Númenor's power and ambition.
Structures.Description: While it stands, champions gain +10% health and nearby civic centers receive a defensive aura.
